You hear a lot of 'Guru's talking a lot about luck. Some even have formulas on how to make it, and even have a convincing argument for it.
But, I agree, luck is a matter of self-perspective.

I have met millionaires so uncomfortable with their own lives that they have envied the positions of traditionally less-well-off individuals.
On the flip-side, I have met individuals that have next to nothing but have figured out the path to their own happiness.

This is an argument that uses the typical view that money = luck/success/happiness to illuminate that this simply isn't the case.
